text: Original Level 1 Level 2 Level 3 Level 4 Level 1: problem statement reconstruction A generator LLM reorders, paraphrases and prunes the issue; a verifier LLM checks no task-defining constraint was lost and triggers a refinement if one was; a human engineer reviews the result ( §III-B , §III-F ).

section: the four levels
text: Level 2: namespace mapping Repository-owned identifiers (classes, functions, module variables, import references, files, directories) are extracted from the syntax tree; Python builtins, keywords and third-party names are filtered out; each identifier is split into tokens, each token mapped to a "semantically plausible" alternative under a seed, and names rebuilt keeping CamelCase, snake_case and UPPER_CASE.
